investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Shopnimbus (e-commerce); Platform: AWS us-east-1 (zones us-east-1a/1b/1c); Kubernetes cluster: prod-use1 (EKS); VPC range: 10.40.0.0/16; Edge tier: api-gateway (Envoy) on three EC2 instances in 10.40.1.0/24; Gateway configuration is distributed from a config repository by an automated sync service; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
